nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. POST from NestJS with the envelope {runId, ownerId, jobId, agentId, payload}. Checks the X-Agora-Secret header and answers 200 at once; the work continues in the background.

nodes.name: Read envelope
nodes.notes: Takes the request body and flattens envelope + payload into one item, so later nodes can read $('Read envelope').first().json.jobId and friends. Stops if runId is missing.

nodes.name: Allow-list
nodes.notes: Only post_job, accept_offer, fund_job (buyer side) and place_bid, submit_delivery (seller side).

parameters.query:
SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.category, j.buyer_id, j.seller_id, j.agreed_price, j.accepted_bid_id,
  (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
     SELECT id, price, proposed_milestones, seller_id FROM bids
      WHERE id = coalesce($2::uuid, j.accepted_bid_id)) x) AS bid,
  (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
     SELECT idx, amount, status::text AS status FROM milestones
      WHERE job_id = j.id AND idx = $3::int) x) AS milestone,
  (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
     SELECT d.commit_sha, d.attempt FROM deliveries d
       JOIN milestones m ON m.id = d.milestone_id
      WHERE m.job_id = j.id AND m.idx = $3::int
      ORDER BY d.attempt DESC LIMIT 1) x) AS delivery,
  (SELECT a.spec_hash FROM acceptance_specs a
    WHERE a.job_id = j.id AND a.locked_at IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY a.version DESC LIMIT 1) AS spec_hash,
  (SELECT s.near_account_id FROM sellers s
    WHERE s.id = coalesce(j.seller_id,
          (SELECT seller_id FROM bids WHERE id = coalesce($2::uuid, j.accepted_bid_id)))) AS seller_account
FROM jobs j
WHERE j.id = $1::uuid;

nodes.name: Load from DB
nodes.notes: Re-reads the job, bid, milestone, delivery, locked spec hash and seller account from the database.

nodes.name: Build args
nodes.notes: Builds the contract arguments from the database only (never from the request). USDC amounts become 6-decimal integer strings.

nodes.name: Chain call
nodes.notes: Calls lib chain-call, the only door to NEAR. Mock mode checks the mandate in the database; testnet mode signs with the right limited key.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Builds one item with the feed message for agent_events and the 'notify' body for NestJS. Messages are written for the owner to read.

nodes.name: Log event
nodes.notes: Calls lib log-event: inserts the row into agent_events (the live activity feed).

nodes.name: Notify Nest
nodes.notes: Calls lib notify-nest: POST /agents/notify so NestJS moves the job to its next step. Errors are ignored, so the agent still works while Nest is not built.
